name: Virginia Beach

neighborhoods.name: Oceanfront
neighborhoods.homes: condos, cottages and apartments near the beach

housing: Virginia Beach rentals are mostly single-family houses, townhomes and apartment complexes, with condos and cottages near the oceanfront.

tenantHelp.name: Legal Aid Society of Eastern Virginia
tenantHelp.what: free legal help for low-income renters

climate: Humidity and coastal storms mean you should check for mold, water stains and window leaks, test the air conditioning, and ask about flood risk and hurricane shutters.
fact: Naval Air Station Oceana and other Hampton Roads bases bring frequent military moves, so many leases include a military clause.
